cānura.p: [¿] (pu) CL=10 A boxer named Cānura.
pn: Cānura. A wrestler employed by Kaṁsa to fight the Andhakaveṇhudāsaputtā. But Baladeva put a strap round him and, lifting him up, dashed his brains out on the ground. Ja.iv.81f.
a: စာနုရမည်သောလက်ဝှေ့သမား။
